# Aaryan Goswami — Portfolio Summary

## Profile
Aaryan Goswami is a B.Tech Computer Science and Engineering graduate from Meerut, India, specializing in Java Full-Stack Development and Backend Engineering. He focuses on building clean REST APIs, microservices, and robust database architectures.

## Technical Toolkit
- Languages: Java (JDK 21), Object-Oriented Programming (OOP)
- Frameworks & Backends: Spring Boot, Java Servlets, REST APIs, Apache Tomcat
- Databases & Persistence: MySQL, JDBC, JPA (Java Persistence API)
- Workflow & Logic: Git, GitHub, Linux, Data Structures and Algorithms (DSA)

## Selected Technical Projects
1. Switchly (Feature Flag API)
   - Built with Java and Spring Boot.
   - Manages feature toggles with strict HTTP method behaviors, clean deletion protocols, and customized API exception codes.
2. Codeforces README Generator
   - Built with Java Servlets, Apache Tomcat, and MySQL.
   - Automates profile tracking by fetching individual Codeforces performance metadata and generating dynamic markdown documentation files.
